tasks.title: Browser workspace and project roadmap
tasks.acceptance: Responsive workspace, local JSON preview, accessible navigation and filterable forty-task roadmap work.
tasks.verification: npm run build; npm run test:browser

tasks.title: Validated runtime and constrained web server
tasks.acceptance: Configuration fails closed; no engine admission, same-origin paths, health scopes, no-store configuration and path containment are tested.

tasks.title: Automated build and verification pipeline
tasks.acceptance: Pinned Actions build the application, run web tests and publish a web-only CI artifact. Remote run result is recorded separately.
tasks.verification: npm run check; npm run test:browser

tasks.title: Web release packaging and operator configuration
tasks.acceptance: Package contains runnable web server, assets, checksums and provenance; TLS proxy and hardened systemd templates are supplied, not deployed.

tasks.title: Reconcile web delivery with product plans
tasks.acceptance: All supplied forty product intents and requirements remain traceable. Existing code and protected configuration are preserved.

tasks.title: KeyHelix engine integration
tasks.acceptance: Implement the first domain slice from IMPLEMENTATION_BLUEPRINT.md through the browser; return real typed results and failures.

tasks.title: Private identity and permission boundaries
tasks.acceptance: Establish project-scoped identity, object authorization, CSRF for cookie mutations, bounded work and redacted audit before enabling a private engine API.
tasks.verification: Authenticated positive and negative integration tests

tasks.title: Observed host deployment and recovery
tasks.acceptance: Provision an owned domain/TLS and approved private admission, install artifact, observe health, validate persistence/provider recovery and retain measured evidence.
tasks.verification: Operator install, update, rollback and restore drill
